title: Neural Actor--Critic Learning with Minimax Critics and Reflected Langevin Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.03352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Actor--critic methods rely on critic gradients to improve continuous-action policies, yet finite-sample guarantees must control both value and gradient errors and their propagation through the actor. We develop a neural actor-critic procedure that combines a regularized minimax Bellman estimator over sigmoid networks with a finite reflected Langevin sampler driven by the fitted critic gradient. Under uniform Bellman regularity and covered reset sampling, a positive high-order action-derivative penalty yields value and action-gradient risk bounds with classical nonparametric minimax exponents up to logarithmic factors. We propagate estimation, mixing, discretization, temperature, and policy-iteration errors to obtain return guarantees, with refinements for bounded multimodal potentials and strongly concave regimes. Empirical studies across controlled simulations, logged continuous-control data, and a simulated decision task show

translated_title: 基于极小极大评论家与反射朗之万采样的神经演员-评论家学习
translated_abstract: 演员-评论家方法依赖评论家的梯度来改进连续动作策略，但有限样本保证必须同时控制价值误差与梯度误差及其在演员端的传播。我们提出了一种神经演员-评论家算法，该方法将基于S形网络的正则化极小极大贝尔曼估计器与由拟合评论家梯度驱动的有限反射朗之万采样器相结合。在一致贝尔曼正则性与覆盖重置采样条件下，正的高阶动作导数惩罚可带来具有经典非参数极小极大指数（至多相差对数因子）的价值与动作梯度风险界。我们将估计误差、混合误差、离散化误差、温度误差与策略迭代误差进行传播，从而获得回报保证，并针对有界多峰势函数与强凹情形给出了精细化结果。在受控仿真、记录的连续控制数据以及模拟决策任务上的实证研究表明……
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合正则化极小极大贝尔曼评论家估计与反射朗之万采样的神经演员-评论家算法，并给出了达到非参数极小极大最优速率的有限样本价值误差界与策略回报保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neural actor-critic algorithm combining regularized minimax Bellman critics with reflected Langevin sampling, achieving finite-sample value and return guarantees with classical nonparametric minimax optimal rates.
